title: Traffic and crowd on the overpass by lastraindrop
author: lastraindrop
sourceDescription: This sound was captured on an overpass, where the rumble of traffic below blends with the sound of passersby. The roar of vehicles tearing through the streets, mingled with echoes and reverberations, creates a low, resonant atmosphere. It was a rainy day, the ground slick with moisture, adding a subtle dampness to the air. All in all, it’s just the ordinary scene of city life. Recorded on February 22, 2025, at 5:00 PM, with some wind effect.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -12.80 dBFS); 30 ms fades
